description: DDL replays as MySQL applies it: a repeated CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS changes nothing; FIRST and AFTER place a column an ADD COLUMN, MODIFY or CHANGE adds or moves, so SELECT * scans in table order; CREATE TABLE ... LIKE, in both spellings, copies a table's columns and key; RENAME TABLE renames tables and views, moving one to another database; and a table-level or later primary key makes its columns NOT NULL
